views.title: On-Device iMessage Web Client, PWA/IWA & REST + SSE API

views.markdown:
**meowtxt** (`dev.sillyangel.meowtxt`) runs a lightweight rootless daemon (`meowd`) on your iPhone (port **8737**) that bridges `IMCore`, `imagent`, `StatusKit`, `sms.db`, and `AddressBook` to a fast, modern web app, Progressive Web App (PWA), Chrome Isolated Web App (IWA), and full CORS REST + Server-Sent Events (SSE) API.

### Highlights
- **Real-Time iMessage Sync:** Instant incoming/outgoing messages, tapbacks, inline replies, bubble/screen effects, iOS 16 Edit & Unsend, and live typing bubbles.
- **Web Push & Browser Notifications:** Real-time desktop/mobile notifications when messages are **received**, **sent**, **delivered**, or **read**, plus webhook forwarding.
- **Focus / Do Not Disturb Sync:** Live recipient Focus/DND banner (`StatusKit`) + manual **Notify Anyway** override (`POST /api/notify`).
- **Two-Way Pinned Chats & Contact Avatars:** Syncs pinned conversations directly with native iOS Messages (`IMPinnedConversationsController`) and streams contact photos & HEIC thumbnails.
- **Next.js / React / AI Ready:** Includes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec (`/api/openapi.json`), full CORS headers, and Cross-Origin Isolation headers for Chrome Isolated Web Apps.

- Added real-time Web Notifications (`event: notification` SSE + Service Worker + `/api/notifications` & `/api/notifications/test`) when messages are **received**, **sent**, **delivered**, or **read**.
- Added custom SVG/PNG icons, `manifest.webmanifest`, `/.well-known/manifest.webmanifest`, and Service Worker (`sw.js`) for full PWA & Chrome Isolated Web App (IWA) support.
- Added Focus / Do Not Disturb (`StatusKit`) header banner and manual **Notify Anyway** override (`POST /api/notify`).
- Added iOS 16 Edit (`POST /api/edit`), Unsend (`POST /api/unsend`), and OpenAPI 3.1 (`GET /api/openapi.json`).
- Added Sileo icon, banner, and native depiction metadata.
- Initial release of `meowd` and the built-in web client with two-way synced pinned chats, contact avatars, HEIC transcoding, and live typing indicators.
